description: After a fix for an issue ships, start a server-side check of whether it comes back: occurrences on the fix release (or the next release seen) and later, against how many sessions reached that release, over a horizon of up to 14 days. It keeps running after this session. Read the result later with get_watch. The result is never "fixed": it is recurred, no recurrence in N sessions, or not enough evidence.

environment.description: Only this environment, e.g. "production". Omit for every environment.

horizonDays.description: How long to watch once the release is seen. Default 7.

issueId.description: The issue id (from list_issues) or its Vinktar URL, as a person would paste it.

minExposure.description: Sessions (or events) the release must reach before a clean result counts. Default 100.

release.description: The release that carries the fix, exactly as the SDK reports it. Omit to watch the next release first seen after now.

name: watch_issue
title: Watch issue
